comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Item 0 is quotation presence: any comment verbatim or near-verbatim quotes OP title or body text, whether or not it is endorsed or refuted. Item 1 is whether any comment gives a reasoned counterargument, with evidence or an example, opposing the OP's view. A comment can quote the OP without arguing against it, and a substantive rebuttal can paraphrase without quoting. Their eligibility rules and null rules also differ.
